text:
jin: Quick heads-up — noticed tail latency spikes from the continuous packing path this morning. Tiny requests (<50 tokens) jump from ~12ms to ~120ms intermittently.

sarah: Ugh. Any pattern (tenant, model, sequence length)?

jin: Mostly small-SEQ chat completions, high QPS tenants hitting the same GPU. Seems correlated with coalesce window growth when backlog oscillates.

omar: Is this the microburst smoothing we enabled last week? Could be hysteresis in the packer.

jin: @omar maybe. I captured a short trace — relevant bit below: 

```
pack-start: t=0.0 size=3 headroom=0.002
wait-for-fill: t=0.006 -> t=0.090
dispatch: t=0.091 latency=0.110
kvcache-pin: t=0.092
```

Looks like we hold for fill for ~80ms occasionally.

omar: That wait-for-fill is the culprit. Our filling heuristic bets on a coming request to amortize kernel launch. When it misses, tiny requests pay the penalty.

jin: Right. Options I see: reduce max wait (improve latency but hurt throughput), make size-aware deadlines (short requests bypass), or predictive fill using recent inter-arrival stats per-tenant.

tess: Can we do per-tenant adaptive deadlines? Tenants with many tiny requests get short deadlines, big-batch tenants keep long ones. Needs signals: recent mean IAT, token distribution.

omar: That was our earlier idea but worried about noisy IAT estimates causing thrash. Maybe use exponential smoothing + floor.

jin: Proposal sketch:
- maintain EMA_iat for tenant
- deadline = clamp(alpha * EMA_iat, min_deadline, max_deadline)
- if request.tokens < small_threshold -> bypass if queue empty for > bypass_grace

Pros: localized, low overhead. Cons: more per-tenant state, cold-start for new tenants.

sarah: Curious about KV cache effects — if we bypass and dispatch more small requests, do we increase KV cache churn and memory pressure? Could hurt large-context requests.

omar: Good point. Need budget: per-GPU KV window for tiny fast-path. If tiny-path usage > X% -> demote to batch path. Simple leaky-bucket counter.

jin: Also found a case where the packer reorders arrivals to fit a kernel (token affinity). That increases head-of-line blocking for some tenants. Maybe keep soft ordering per-tenant when QPS low.

tess: So action items?
1) Add telemetry for `wait-for-fill` distribution broken down by tenant/model/seq-len. (owner: jin)
2) Prototype per-tenant EMA_iat + deadline clamp in sim harness. (owner: omar)
3) Simulate KV cache pressure with increased tiny-path dispatch and tune demotion threshold. (owner: tess)
4) Small-path ordering experiment: preserve per-tenant order when queue length < N. (owner: sarah)

deploy-bot: test-run scheduled: staging/pack-sim on 2024-08-12 02:00 UTC :rocket:

jin: I'll push the telemetry PR today. Keeping the ramp slow — don't want to flip heuristics in prod without sim results. :thumbsup:

sarah: Thanks. If anyone sees a repeat on prod, DM me with the trace id so I can grab kernel metrics.

omar: Also let's add a gauge for `tiny_path_eviction_rate` to catch KV churn early.

tess: noted.

jin: Filed tracking issue: infra/pack-scheduler#842. I'll link the sim results once available.

sarah: Sounds good. Quick wins first: telemetry + one sim experiment.

jin: cool, closing here for now. :white_check_mark:
